title: Design System: Fitness Coach — Cuaderno de Hierro

display.purpose: Page-level H1 titles in PageHeader and the login hero heading.

headline.purpose: Primary panel titles such as active Fase Nutricional and Evidence Card titles.

title.purpose: Sub-section headings, Markdown headings in Coach replies, and modal titles.

body.purpose: Reading copy (max 65–70ch measure), form controls, and data tables.

label.purpose: Field labels, status badges, segmented tab triggers, and compact metadata.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Subtle grounding shadow under default surfaces and assistant message cards.

shadows.name: focal-accent
shadows.purpose: Precision 2px top brass accent bar for the single focal panel on a screen.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, mobile bottom sheets, and the login focal container.

motion.name: transition-standard
motion.purpose: Color, border, and background transitions on buttons, fields, tabs, and disclosures.

motion.name: transition-reduced
motion.purpose: Clamped color/opacity transition applied when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Athlete action in Calibrated Brass with 44px mobile touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid transparent; background: rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); color: rgb(var(--c-accent-ink, 22 18 11)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(var(--c-accent-hover, 226 178 96)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Calm steel-surface button for secondary actions, steppers, and cancel controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line-strong, 98 110 130)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(var(--c-surface-muted, 36 42 54)); border-color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244) / 0.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Focal Surface Card
components.description: Primary focal panel with precision 2px top Calibrated Brass accent bar.
components.html:
Fase Nutricional activa

2350 kcal · Ritmo objetivo -0.4 kg/sem · Proteína 180 g
components.css: .ds-surface-focal { border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 8px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 48 56 71)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); padding: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75) / 0.78), var(--shadow-panel, 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32)); } .ds-surface-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Archivo', sans-serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); } .ds-surface-copy { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 164 173 187)); }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: High-contrast form input with brass focus ring and tabular numeral support.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 164 173 187)); } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line-strong, 98 110 130)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 0; border-color: rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75) / 0.25); }

components.name: Evidence Status Badge
components.description: Glacier Science pill tag for methodological evidence grade on Fichas de Evidencia.
components.css: .ds-badge-science { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-secondary, 99 164 219) / 0.35); background: rgb(var(--c-secondary-soft, 27 48 68)); color: rgb(var(--c-secondary-text, 144 196 238)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Navigation Rail Item
components.description: Desktop rail navigation item with 2px left brass indicator bar when active.
components.html: Coach
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: rgb(var(--c-rail-ink-muted, 152 162 178)); transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(var(--c-rail-surface, 27 32 41)); color: rgb(var(--c-rail-ink, 236 239 244)); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgb(var(--c-rail-active-bg, 48 42 29)); color: rgb(var(--c-rail-active-ink, 226 181 102)); } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--c-rail-active-ink, 226 181 102)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Keyboard-navigable segmented control for multi-view workflows (Entrenamiento, Nutrición, Ciencia).
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 4px; border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 8px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 48 56 71)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface-muted, 36 42 54) / 0.7); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 164 173 187)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); } .ds-tab-active { background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); } .ds-tab-dot { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--c-accent-soft, 56 46 27)); color: rgb(var(--c-accent-text, 233 192 120)); font-size: 11px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inline HelpTip Disclosure
components.description: Zero-popper accessible inline glossary help trigger (44x44px mobile touch target, 30px desktop) and Glacier Science note for RIR, TDEE, PEDs, and scientific validity.
components.html: Repeticiones en recámara (RIR): Estima cuántas repeticiones válidas podrías haber completado antes del fallo muscular.
components.css: .ds-helptip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-helptip-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-secondary, 99 164 219) / 0.45); background: rgb(var(--c-secondary-soft, 27 48 68)); color: rgb(var(--c-secondary-text, 144 196 238)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-helptip-btn { min-height: 30px; min-width: 30px; } } .ds-helptip-btn:hover { background: rgb(var(--c-secondary, 99 164 219) / 0.2); } .ds-helptip-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-helptip-note { max-width: 65ch; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-secondary, 99 164 219) / 0.35); background: rgb(var(--c-secondary-soft, 27 48 68) / 0.65); color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 164 173 187)); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-helptip-note strong { color: rgb(var(--c-secondary-text, 144 196 238)); }

components.name: Confirm Action Button
components.description: Two-step inline destructive confirmation replacing window.confirm with an inline Confirmar + Cancelar group.
components.css: .ds-confirm-group { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-danger, 227 98 108) / 0.45); background: rgb(var(--c-danger-soft, 66 26 33)); color: rgb(var(--c-danger-text, 247 161 168)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-cancel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line-strong, 98 110 130)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 236 239 244)); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-danger, .ds-btn-cancel { min-height: 36px; } } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible, .ds-btn-cancel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--c-accent, 212 161 75)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-chart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 8px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 48 56 71)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-chart-summary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px 24px; margin: 0; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 48 56 71)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-chart-summary dt { color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 164 173 187)); } .ds-chart-summary dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chart-accent { color: rgb(var(--c-accent-text, 233 192 120)); } .ds-chart-success { color: rgb(var(--c-success-text, 135 224 176)); } .ds-chart-svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

components.description: Zero-dependency responsive SVG vertical bar chart for multi-week effective hypertrophy set volume with optional planned target reference line and accessible table.
components.css: .ds-barchart { padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 8px); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-line, 48 56 71)); background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 28 33 43)); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-barchart-svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

narrative.overview:
Fitness Coach is an Operate-mode training, nutrition, and sports-science workspace built like a calibrated steel training notebook. Its default dark appearance is engineered for dim gym floors and one-handed mobile logging, while a matched high-contrast light appearance serves bright desk reviews without altering hierarchy or spatial rhythm.

Every visual decision serves calm precision, rapid numerical scanning, and clear separation between personal tracking and curated scientific evidence. Rather than chasing fitness-app neon gradients or motivational clutter, the interface relies on disciplined slate-steel layers, warm calibrated brass for primary actions, cool glacier blue for scientific credibility, and crisp tabular numerals across loads, reps, RIR, calories, and progression charts.

The design system rejects decorative cards-within-cards, gradient text, eyebrow kickers above headings, hard neobrutalist block shadows, and emoji icon substitutes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first architectural steel palette with an exact semantic light theme twin via html[data-theme="light"].
Warm Calibrated Brass reserved strictly for primary actions, focal borders, and active selection states.
Glacier Science blue dedicated exclusively to curated evidence, inline contextual help, and Curador role markers.
Crisp mechanical geometry (6px controls, 8px panels) paired with tabular numerals and ≥44px mobile touch targets.
Progressive disclosure for secondary workflows (advanced search filters, inline glossary help, disposable onboarding, two-step destructive confirmations).

rules.name: The Brass Budget Rule
rules.body: Calibrated Brass marks primary actions, current selection, focus rings, and at most one focal panel per screen. Never flood inactive controls or multiple competing banners with primary accent fills.

rules.name: The Epistemological Color Rule
rules.body: Glacier Science denotes curated evidence, scientific help, and Curador tools; Amber Caution denotes quarantined external sources or pending proposals. Never mix those semantic tones across boundaries.

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every numeric measurement—loads (kg/lb), reps, RIR, e1RM, calories, macros, weight trends, and counts—must enable font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns and steppers stay rock-steady during input.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Operate Rule
rules.body: Use fixed rem steps rather than fluid clamp() headings inside authenticated surfaces so hierarchy stays predictable across desktop rails and mobile viewports.

rules.name: The Single Focal Surface Rule
rules.body: Show at most one Surface variant="focal" per screen so the Athlete immediately recognizes the primary work surface.

rules.name: The Flat-Inset Rule
rules.body: Recessed containers (Surface variant="inset"), table shells, and grouped exercise rows stay flat with hairline borders—never nest elevated shadows inside another card.

dos: Do preserve strict GLOSSARY.md Spanish terminology across every label, button, error, and help disclosure (Atleta, Coach, Curador, Perfil Vivo, Mesociclo, Sesión de Entrenamiento, Fase Nutricional, Check-in, Base de Conocimiento, Ficha de Evidencia, Estudio Candidato, Corte Mensual).
Do keep at most one Surface variant="focal" visible per view and use Surface variant="inset" for secondary or empty-state guidance.
Do enforce ≥44px minimum touch targets on mobile for every interactive button, stepper, link, and HelpTip trigger.
Do apply tabular-nums to all loads, reps, RIR, macro/calorie counts, chart axes, and table columns, and wrap Markdown tables in overflow-x-auto.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion by keeping state transitions calm (120–200ms) and disabling pulse/spin animations when reduced motion is requested.
Do verify every color combination meets WCAG AA (≥4.5:1 body/placeholder text, ≥3:1 large text and interactive borders) in both dark and light themes.
donts: Don't place eyebrow kickers, decorative section numbers (01 / 02 / 03), gradient text, or emoji stand-ins for icons anywhere in the interface.
Don't nest shadowed cards inside cards or add colored thick border-left / border-right stripes (>1px) to cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't use raw fetch() in frontend code or add heavy third-party charting/popper libraries; use apiClient and native semantic SVG/HTML primitives.
Don't reach for a modal when an inline disclosure (HelpTip, collapsible filters, ConfirmActionButton, inline thread rename) solves the task without interrupting flow.
Don't expose Curador navigation or endpoints to non-Curador Atletas or mix quarantined live search results with approved Fichas de Evidencia.
